summary: Validates receiver configuration fields (0x168/0x16C/0x170/0x174 must be 0/63/0/0), then iterates the sprite object array at this+0x124 and, per object, reads two channel indices (sprite+0x14, sprite+0x18), validates each index (must be < 4 and have a non-null buffer at this+0xA0/0xB0 region), copies both channel buffers into per-object decode-state slots via sub_51A5EA, and zeroes each state slot. Finally resets the decode state fields at state+8/+12/+16/+20/+24 and state+32, writes state+48 = this[0xFC], and returns that value.

local_names.a1: receiver object (this); vtable at +0x0, error-handler slot at +0x4, error fields at +0x14/+0x18, count at 0x120, sprite array at 0x124, decode state pointer at 0x194
local_names.v2: decode state pointer read from a1[101] (this+0x194)
local_names.v3: channel index A read from sprite object +0x14
local_names.v4: channel index B read from sprite object +0x18 (kept in v6 after the first check)
local_names.v6: copy of channel index B preserved across the channel-A validation branch
local_names.v7: per-object loop counter compared against a1[72] (this+0x120)
local_names.v8: walker over per-object decode-state slots at state+32
local_names.v9: walker over sprite object array entries starting at a1[73] (this+0x124)

operations.description: Configuration validation: if a1[90] || a1[91] != 63 || a1[92] || a1[93] (fields this+0x168, +0x16C, +0x170, +0x174), the receiver is rejected.
On configuration validation failure, write error code 118 into the vtable error-code field at obj+0x14.
On configuration validation failure, dispatch the error handler through vtable slot at obj+0x4 with arguments (a1, -1); reads the vtable pointer at obj/this+0x0.
v2 = a1[101]: read the decode state pointer from field this+0x194.
Loop guard: process objects only while a1[72] (this+0x120, object count) is > 0.
Iterate the sprite object array starting at a1[73] (this+0x124). Per object, read channel index A at sprite+0x14 and channel index B at sprite+0x18.
Channel-A validity check: v3 >= 4, or the indexed buffer a1[v3+40] (this+0xA0 region) is null.
On channel-A failure, write error code 49 into obj+0x14 and the offending channel index v3 into obj+0x18.
On channel-A failure, dispatch the error handler through the vtable slot at obj+0x0 with argument (a1); reads the vtable pointer at obj/this+0x0.
Channel-B validity check: v6 >= 4, or the indexed buffer a1[v6+44] (this+0xB0 region) is null.
On channel-B failure, write error code 49 into obj+0x14 and the offending channel index v6 into obj+0x18.
On channel-B failure, dispatch the error handler through the vtable slot at obj+0x0 with argument (a1); reads the vtable pointer at obj/this+0x0.
sub_51A5EA(a1, a1[v3+40], state + 52 + 4*v3): copy the channel-A buffer into the per-object destination slot in the decode state.
sub_51A5EA(a1, a1[v6+44], state + 68 + 4*v6): copy the channel-B buffer into the per-object destination slot in the decode state.
Zero the per-object decode-state slot: *v8 = 0 where v8 walks the state+32 array (field this+0x1B4).
Reset decode-state counters: state+8, +12, +16, +20 are all zeroed (fields this+0x19C, +0x1A0, +0x1A4, +0x1A8).
Zero the decode-state byte at state+24 (field this+0x1AC).
Write state+48 = a1[63] (field this+0x1C4 = field this+0xFC); this copies the receiver reference value into the decode state.
Return a1[63] (this+0xFC), the same value just copied into the decode state.
